name: 圣光降临
description: 选择6格内1个地格。该格中的友军治疗9点，敌军受到9点法术伤害；距离1格的单位治疗或受到7点法术伤害；距离2、3格的单位治疗或受到4点法术伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { const sourcePiece = context.piece; const targetCell = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 6 }); if (!targetCell || targetCell.needsTargetSelection) return targetCell; const centerX = targetCell.x; const centerY = targetCell.y; const atDistance = function(dist) { return battle.pieces.filter(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && Math.abs(piece.x - centerX) + Math.abs(piece.y - centerY) === dist; }); }; const applyRing = function(pieces, value) { const allies = pieces.filter(function(piece) { return piece.ownerPlayerId === sourcePiece.ownerPlayerId; }); const enemies = pieces.filter(function(piece) { return piece.ownerPlayerId !== sourcePiece.ownerPlayerId; }); if (allies.length) healDamage(sourcePiece, allies, value, battle, context.skill.id); if (enemies.length) dealDamage(sourcePiece, enemies, value, 'magical', battle, context.skill.id); }; applyRing(atDistance(0), 9); applyRing(atDistance(1), 7); applyRing(atDistance(2), 4); applyRing(atDistance(3), 4); return { success: true, message: sourcePiece.name + '释放了圣光降临' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview() { return { description: '中心治疗或造成9点法术伤害；距离1格为7点；距离2、3格为4点。', expectedValues: { centerHeal: 9, centerDamage: 9, adjacentHeal: 7, adjacentDamage: 7, distantHeal: 4, distantDamage: 4 } }; }
